# teams_emergency_call_routing_policy (Resource)

Manages the EmergencyCallRoutingPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsEmergencyCallRoutingPolicy / Get-CsTeamsEmergencyCallRoutingPolicy / Set-CsTeamsEmergencyCallRoutingPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsEmergencyCallRoutingPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `allow_enhanced_emergency_services` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowEnhancedEmergencyServices parameter.
- `description` (String) Maps to the -Description parameter.
- `emergency_numbers` (String) Maps to the -EmergencyNumbers parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
